title: Create NoobCraft
description: Build, automate, and survive together on the official Create NoobCraft server pack.
body:
# Create NoobCraft - Official Server Modpack

**Create NoobCraft** is the official modpack for joining the NoobCraft server.

It includes the required Create-based gameplay mods needed for multiplayer, plus a curated set of optional client-side improvements for performance, UI, maps, shaders, and quality of life. Install the pack, launch it, and the server will already be in your multiplayer list.

---

## Purpose of This Pack

This pack exists to:

- Keep every player on the correct Minecraft, NeoForge, and mod versions
- Provide a stable multiplayer setup for the NoobCraft server
- Support Create-focused automation, storage, travel, and exploration
- Offer helpful client-side upgrades without making them required on the server
- Keep the pack approachable for friends who just want to install and play

This is not a giant kitchen-sink modpack. It is curated specifically for the NoobCraft server.

---

## What to Expect

### Create-Based Gameplay

The server is centered around Create automation and engineering:

- Mechanical power systems
- Factories, item routing, and processing chains
- Create Deco, Create: Bells & Whistles, Create: Trading Floor, and other Create integrations
- Extra Create-compatible storage and backpack support

### Storage & Inventory

NoobCraft includes a practical storage setup for long-term multiplayer survival:

- Sophisticated Backpacks for portable, upgradeable storage
- Storage Drawers for bulk item storage
- Create compatibility addons for smoother automation workflows

### Travel & Exploration

- Waystones for fast travel between important locations
- Xaero’s Minimap and World Map as optional client-side navigation tools

### UI & Information

The pack includes useful client-side tools for learning and playing comfortably:

- Jade and Jade Addons for block/entity information
- Just Enough Items (JEI) for recipe lookup
- AppleSkin, BetterF3, Shulker Box Tooltip, Mouse Tweaks, and inventory sorting helpers

### Performance & Stability

Server and client performance were a major focus:

- ModernFix
- FerriteCore
- Spark on the server
- Sodium, Iris, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, and Dynamic FPS as optional client-side performance mods

### Visuals

The pack includes optional visual upgrades for players who want a nicer-looking game:

- Iris shader support
- Complementary Reimagined shader pack
- Create-style backpack visuals
- Fusion resource packs
- Low on Fire
- Default Dark Mode

Shaders and resource packs may need to be enabled manually in your client settings.

---

## Installation

1. Install the modpack through Modrinth.
2. Launch the pack with Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge.
3. Open Multiplayer.
4. Join the included NoobCraft server entry.

The server uses a whitelist, so you must be approved before joining.

---

## Notes

- Required server mods are managed by the pack.
- Optional client-side mods are included for convenience but are not required by the server.
- Do not manually remove required gameplay mods if you plan to join NoobCraft.
- Extra personal client-side mods may work, but they are not officially supported.
- The pack is intentionally curated for stability, compatibility, and easy installs.
